The intended implementation style is deliberately evidence-oriented. MadLava MUST report observable facts, their source, and their accuracy. It MUST NOT turn correlation into automatic causality, constructors into total allocation counts, or Throwable construction into a fabricated application-failure count.

- the repository MUST include an offline visual viewer with timelines, rankings, collapsible detail and raw inspection;
